finalText:
**Bigger than it sounds, and three spots must stay `account_id`.**

`account_id` shows up in 1082 places across 94 files. Most are the app's own repo/service/route layers (accounts, orders, billing, notify, analytics) doing tenant scoping — mechanical, renameable.

Do not rename in:

| Location | Reason |
|---|---|
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/*` | Vendored, generated. Header says local edits get overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh`. |
| `migrations/*.sql` (all applied ones) | Already run in prod. Editing them doesn't rename a live column and breaks the `down` step. A rename needs a *new* migration. |
| `lib/serialize.js` `WIRE.account_id` | Public API field, documented in `docs/openapi.yaml`, read by name by every client. Comment marks it frozen. |

`docs/openapi.yaml` also exposes `account_id` as a public field name and query param — renaming it is a breaking API change, separate decision from the internal rename.

Next: sign off on the internal rename in services code, but carve out vendor, applied migrations, and the public wire contract as out of scope.
